purpose: Final captured emulator audio validation of native SCSP register implementation; no music WAV is used at Saturn runtime.
status: PASS for sequence presence, measured cadence, clipping and agreement with the native SCSP reference, within the listed limits.

alignment.method: Highpass waveform matching of original individual OKI sample output in each native SCSP event window; one constant integer offset per loop. No sample-rate fit or time stretch.
alignment.interpretation: A capture/model offset includes audio filtering and IRQ latency; the alignment origin is not asserted to be the physical instant wp01_audio_start executes.

clean_video_cut.method: Measured exact digital silence before the fourth loop; no fade, replacement, normalization or audio mixing is required.

seven_component_linear_fit.interpretation: All coefficients are positive. This supports presence of every modeled component but is not an independent per-slot trace. High-frequency phase differences particularly reduce the FM7 coefficient; it must not be read as a direct channel-volume measurement.

conclusions: Nineteen original PCM starts per loop are located in the first three repetitions. Their within-loop relative timing differs by at most one output sample (22.676 microseconds).
The measured repeated audio period follows the independently measured 424-video-frame scene period, with less than one sample error over two periods.
The full waveform and 50ms RMS envelopes closely agree with the explicit native SCSP register model; all seven component-fit coefficients are positive.
No output clipping is observed anywhere in the complete decoded movie audio.
Emulator recording is about 1.5dB lower in RMS than the standalone native core renderer; this is measured, not silently normalized away.
limits: This validates a Mednafen emulator capture, not a physical Saturn recording.
Native SCSP FM is an instrument mapping of original YM2151 notes/operators; it is not a claim of bit-identical YM2151 synthesis.
Host reference schedules writes before integer audio samples, uses a minimum two-sample KYON guard, and does not model SH2 bus bandwidth, IRQ arrival or fractional audio-clock phase.
All-channel presence is supported by mixed-output agreement and the component fit; without an emulator MMIO trace the mixed audio alone cannot prove every individual register reached hardware.

Native runtime resets the entrance after 424 video frames. The original 313219-sample reference window is slightly longer; final comparisons stop before the reset and the last PCM hit is cut by the new entrance.
Matching uses the captured output in a narrow timing window; fitted gains are diagnostic only and are not applied to the release video or BIN.
